items.sourceExcerpt:
SECTION 7.02

Indebtedness

124

items.textValue: Section 7.02, titled 'Indebtedness', is the negative covenant governing incurrence of Indebtedness (the prohibition and its enumerated permitted-debt baskets/exceptions), but no substantive body text for this section was obtainable.

A multi-clause categorical inclusion/exclusion test for what constitutes 'Indebtedness' of a Person: (1) borrowed money, instruments/LCs/bankers' acceptances, deferred purchase price >12 months (with sub-exceptions for trade payables, earn-outs until balance-sheet-recognized and unpaid 60+ days, and ordinary-course payroll accruals), and net Hedging Obligations, in each case (other than LC/Hedging obligations) only if it would appear as a GAAP balance-sheet liability; (2) guarantee-type obligations of a third Person's clause-(1) Indebtedness; and (3) third-party clause-(1) Indebtedness secured by a Lien on the first Person's asset (valued at the lesser of asset FMV and the amount of such Indebtedness) - all subject to a further proviso excluding Contingent Obligations, LC reimbursement obligations (with a 3-Business-Day grace period before counting as Indebtedness), Qualified Securitization Facility obligations (except, for Total Net Leverage Ratio purposes only, amounts over $125.0 million), accrued expenses, deferred/prepaid revenue, and asset retirement/reclamation/workers-compensation obligations, and calculated without giving effect to ASC 815 embedded-derivative accounting effects.
